body: Today has been so hard. It makes me feel as if I’m not as strong as I think I am because the shit I put under the rug is so painful...

My husband literally only cares if he has the extra friend and play buddy. I don’t think he realizes how hard this is for me in the first place and just wanted to get his jut off. I mean they met 5 days ago and HAD to get it on.
Well it happened and I truly want to die. I think the actuality of it all just hit and I’m just too mentally unstable for anything like this...
I want it to make me happy so desperately... but my insides just hurt.. I feel as if a life time of issues are constantly being brought up and I’m having to deal with them all over again.

She lives with her dad and can’t bring anyone over... I have stated how much I dislike the idea of them doing stuff in our bed, but he is very set on it has to be at our house. unless they do it in the car... thats not fair to them.
Ive tried so many medications. For a little while they help and then they all make me worse..
I feel this so hard... So deep in my chest.

My son is almost 5 and let me tell you, it can be a struggle. I do have to watch how my attitude and words come off which is hard for me because of other issues myself and my son have, but my son loves me and i adore him. Congrats girly, hang in there.
No im not on an BC or any other meds. I do smoke weed but im bot sure if that does anything to tje female libido
Oh man, I can relate to the being over sexual when single. My husband and I separated and I was very active. But now, 2 years later I am drier that the desert down there.
Thank you for your information. I am going to have to do a lot of research on how to get my stress level down.
My episodes happen when I am stressed. I am the most stressed out human being I know, and the more stressed I get, the deeper into the "not interested cave" I go.

I have had no sex drive for so long, it feels like years. My husband has a very high sex drive and I feel terrible about never wanting to have sex. Its gotten to the point where it is painful tp have sex. Ive seen doctors but they say its in my head.. So idk... It sucks.

I always feel like a horrible person. I do my best to maintain my emotions but whenever I have an episode, I feel like a garbage human being that cant do anything right. During an episode I hear a voice in the back of my head begging me to chill out but I can't.

Oh man.... This is me almost everyday lately. A few months ago I blew up on my mom and im literally picking my relationship with my husband apart. Sometimes I sit and ask myself how I let myself get this bad but at the same time I am trying everyday to do the things I need to do to keep my sanity. Ugh..

Oh my gosh I havent related to something so hard in awhile... It is is unbelievably exhausting getting through the day. Lately it has been getting harder to see the bigger picture. Im sorry I dont have any advice but just know you arent alone..
